svg.title: One Harbour v2, ship sprite
svg.desc: Expedition cruise ship, side elevation, bow toward +x, 120 m at 5 units per metre. Pivot (300,160): waterline at midship. Bridge window dock point (398,38). Place by translating the pivot onto the route point; never rotate; scale 1. ship-wake shows under way, ship-chain at anchor, ship-lights whenever the ship is on stage. Signal colour appears only inside ship-lights.
